# ERA AXIS

> ERA AXIS is Ghana's practical STEM and digital skills platform. Learners build real projects with real tools, including the ERA Dev Board, a hand-built electronics board. Programmes serve school students (Basic 1 to SHS 3), out-of-school youth (ages 16 to 30), online learners and working professionals.

ERA AXIS was started in 2020, registered as a business in 2024, and incorporated as ERA AXIS Limited in 2026. It is based in Essikado, Ghana. Contact: support@eraaxis.com.

## Programmes

- [All programmes](https://eraaxis.com/programs): the four learning pathways side by side
- [School STEM](https://eraaxis.com/programs/school-stem): hands-on STEM in school, from Basic 1 to SHS 3
- [Out-of-School Youth](https://eraaxis.com/programs/out-of-school-youth): practical tech skills and community projects for ages 16 to 30
- [Online Learning](https://eraaxis.com/programs/online-learning): programming, AI, electronics, PCB design, simulation and automation, online
- [ERA Digital Skills](https://eraaxis.com/programs/era-digital-skills): three months of AI tools, spreadsheets and automation for working adults

## The ERA Dev Board

- [ERA Dev Board](https://eraaxis.com/dev-board): the board learners use, its parts, and what they build on it
